license.sportsdataverse: sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-data is an MIT-licensed repository; the game data inside it is compiled from ESPN's public NBA feeds and remains ESPN's and the NBA's. The repository licence does not grant rights to the underlying data. ESPN's and NBA.com's terms restrict commercial use: the owner must review before NBA output is sold in a paid tier. Attribution is printed on every NBA artifact.
license.nba_stats: stats.nba.com / cdn.nba.com are NOT used: unreachable from this build, and NBA.com's terms of use restrict automated and commercial use. swar/nba_api is an MIT wrapper; its licence grants no rights to NBA.com data.
license.odds: No historical odds archive is licensed here. ESPN's displayed spread (play-by-play game_spread) is untimestamped and names no book: it is kept only as a labelled diagnostic, never a market test and never an ROI basis.
